title: The Unfairness of Fair Machine Learning: Levelling down and strict egalitarianism by default
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of its analysis. The focus is on the philosophical and practical implications of fairness measures in machine learning, particularly the phenomenon of 'levelling down'.
